subject: AI & Agents
title: Synthetic Data: AI Trains on AI
description: A fast breakdown of Synthetic Data: AI Trains on AI for builders.

hook.text: We're running out of internet text to train on. The solution? Have AI generate its own training data.

buildup.text: Synthetic data is artificially generated information that mimics the statistical properties of real data.

discovery.text: Models trained on carefully curated synthetic data can match or exceed those trained on real data.

twist.text: But models trained on their own outputs can collapse — amplifying errors in a feedback loop.

climax.text: The key is careful curation: synthetic data for diversity, real data for grounding in reality.

punchline.text: AI creating its own textbooks. What could go wrong? Or right?

quiz.question: What risk comes with training AI on synthetic data?
options: Models can amplify errors in a feedback loop
Synthetic data is always better than real data
It's impossible to generate synthetic data

details.summary: Synthetic data is artificially generated data used to train AI models. As real data becomes scarce or restricted, AI-generated data increasingly supplements training, raising questions about quality and feedback loops.
details.whyItMatters: Real training data is running out for the largest models. Synthetic data could extend the scaling era but risks creating echo chambers where AI learns from its own mistakes.
takeaways: Synthetic data is AI-generated data used for model training
It helps when real data is scarce, private, or expensive
Feedback loops where AI trains on AI output are a growing concern

faq.question: Can AI trained on synthetic data be as good as AI trained on real data?
faq.answer: For some tasks, yes. High-quality synthetic data carefully curated can match or exceed real data. But training on low-quality synthetic data risks model collapse where diversity and accuracy degrade over generations.

faq.question: What is model collapse from synthetic data?
faq.answer: When AI is trained on data generated by previous AI models, errors compound over generations. The model loses diversity and accuracy, converging on increasingly narrow and distorted outputs. Careful curation mitigates this.
